name: Mt Hutt

source.note: Piste reference data — confirm at source. Approximate ski-area base position (no village; visitors stay in Methven or Christchurch)
Search summary: ski area between 1,438 m and 2,086 m; vertical derived as the difference (648 m). The same summary also quoted a 683 m vertical drop from another result — confirm.

Search summary: 365 hectares (kept in this note), 3 chairlifts and 2 surface lifts (learner carpets, if any, may not be counted); one chair is New Zealand's first high-speed eight-seater. Attribution between the resort's pages and skiresort.com uncertain. Season id 2025-26.
Piste reference data — confirm at source. Only features Piste is confident about are set; everything else is unknown (null), not 'not offered'.

character: A Canterbury ski area above Methven, operated by NZSki and included on the Ikon Pass. Its high-speed eight-seat chairlift was a New Zealand first, and the mountain is the main ski area within reach of Christchurch.
learning: Reference note: learner areas and an NZSki snowsports school are at the base; confirm 2027 lesson products.

source.note: Winter 2026: scheduled closing day Sun 11 Oct 2026 (shared research notes) — still ahead on 2026-09-30. Opening: originally planned for 12 Jun 2026 but delayed by a lack of snow; a search summary said 'the current season opens on 2026-06-27' and snowfall.co.nz floated 27 Jun (https://snowfall.co.nz/news/mt-hutt-opening-day-june-12/). The actual opening day is not confirmed. Planned closing day 2026-10-11 (not yet happened as of 2026-09-30).
Winter 2025 published season dates: 13 Jun – 12 Oct 2025 (scheduled dates; actual days may have differed).

season.typicalText: Usually mid-June to mid-October; the 2026 opening was delayed from 12 Jun to late June.
season.notes: Southern Hemisphere: Piste season id 2026-27 is the June–October 2027 winter (the one the 2026-27 Ikon and Epic passes cover); 2025-26 is the 2026 winter and 2024-25 the 2025 winter. No 2027 opening or closing date was found as of 2026-09-30 (NZSki's 2027 3 Peak Pass was still listed as 'Coming Soon' — https://www.theremarkables.co.nz/passes-packages/). OnTheSnow labels the 2026 NZ winter '2026/2027', so its 'projected' dates describe winter 2026, not 2027.

prices.note: Winter 2026 (OnTheSnow calls it the 2025-2026 season; Piste id 2025-26); same price weekday and weekend.
